title: Reprogramming Complete
description: Babu Frik goes to work on C-3PO. Once the reprogram is successful, threepio sits up and his eyes turn a glowing red, seeming like a completely different droid. When he speaks, his usually fussy demeanor is gone, replaced by an almost frightening electric tone. After croaking out the location of Wayfinder, threepio reboots, his memory completely wiped clean.
